name: Mian
source:
When she's not working as a hostess at night, Mian either follows her dream of modeling or helps her parents at tending the family butcher shop. A very obvious tsundere, she struggles to express her feelings honestly, and although she wants to open up to the people around her, efforts to do so often end in misunderstandings or in Mian reacting angrily to cover up her embarrassment.

[spoiler]Her real name is Kouenji Hikaru (高円寺 ひかる).[/spoiler]
